title: GEOX Invocation Envelope
description: Universal identity + context wrapper for every GEOX tool call in production mode. Propagates actor, session, lease, asset, basin, and tool metadata through the entire call chain.

session_id.description: Governed session ID from arifOS session_init

actor_id.description: Human or agent identity. MUST be non-null, non-anonymous in production mode.

lease_id.description: Scope-of-authority lease identifier. Null if no lease applies.

asset_id.description: Target asset identifier. REQUIRED for asset-scoped workflows.

basin_id.description: Target basin identifier. REQUIRED for basin-scoped workflows.

tool_name.description: MUST match a registered canonical tool name

tool_version.description: Version of the tool being invoked

trace_id.description: UUID for end-to-end tracing across host, shell, tool, store, vault

parent_trace_id.description: Parent trace ID for chained invocations. Null if this is root.

authority_scope.description: Maximum action class authorized for this invocation

mutation_allowed.description: True if this invocation may change artifact/model state

ops_touch_allowed.description: True if this invocation may touch operational systems

human_review_required.description: True if output requires human review before downstream use
